description: Whether a failed publish of tower/gate stops the infra delivery (nothing merges) instead of being logged while the delivery lands (fail-open). True since the ruleset rs_<tower-gate-required> requires tower/gate (revert: origin ruleset delete it, then set this false). It was false while the forge did not require tower/gate; true once the ruleset requires it, because then a head without a green tower/gate cannot merge anyway (D-313).
